description: A withdrawal that leaves the vault rent-exempt returns the requested amount.
A zero request is refused with -1.
An over-withdraw (requested > balance) is refused with -2 instead of underflowing.
A withdrawal that would drop the remainder below the rent-exempt minimum is refused with -3.
The boundary is inclusive: a withdrawal leaving EXACTLY the rent-exempt minimum is allowed. A guard written `remaining <= rent_exempt_min` refuses this and passes every other case.
One lamport past the boundary: leaving rent_exempt_min - 1 is refused with -3.
An over-withdraw that would ALSO breach the rent floor is still -2: the balance check is reached first.
